Import
⌈
The
X.509 Provider
allows to import
ara::crypto::x509::X509Provider::ImportCrl
and update the
CRL
. These
CRL
can be either stored in the
X.509 Provider
separately or in combination with
the certificate. The application or
Functional Cluster
can call the interface
ara::

, which is provided by the
Cryp-
toAPI

⌋
